thread:
Sam Wells: Hey everyone! I'm Sam — excited to join Redwood on Platform today. Quick setup Qs: my laptop MDM hasn't pushed the VPN profile and my SSH to bastion is failing (hangs on 'Authenticating...'). Who should I ping for MDM / VPN, and is there a standard SSH key format you prefer? :wave:
Aisha Patel: welcome Sam!! :tada: Ping @Dev-Helpdesk for MDM and VPN. For SSH, we use ed25519 keys. If you haven't made one:```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "sam.wells@redwood.ai" -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519```then paste the .pub in the portal.
Sam Wells: thanks Aisha — trying that now. Is there a guide for the portal URL? I only have the MDM onboarding doc link from people-ops.
ops-bot: Welcome Sam! Your onboarding checklist has been assigned. VPN installer: https://downloads.redwood.ai/vpn/install (internal). If you need escalations, react with :rotating_light:.
Sam Wells: ok got the VPN link, installing. SSH keygen succeeded. When I try `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 ubuntu@bastion.redwood.internal` it just hangs on `Authenticating...` after password prompt disappears.
Dev-Helpdesk: @Sam Wells can you confirm you uploaded the public key to the SSO portal (Profile -> SSH Keys)? Also confirm MFA device is set up — without MFA the bastion blocks key auth. If both look good, send us the output of `ssh -vvv` (paste a redacted snippet).
Sam Wells: uploaded key and MFA is set. Here's minimal `ssh -vvv` snippet: "debug1: Authentications that can continue: publickey,password" then it loops.
Noor Khan: hi Sam — that's usually the agent forwarding or permissions on the key. Run `chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and ensure `~/.ssh` is 700. Also check `ssh-add -l` to see if the key is loaded. If you're on mac, sometimes the keychain interfere s.
Sam Wells: chmod fixed it! I can connect. VPN + bastion up. Huge thanks team. Where should I post my dev machine spec for inventory?
Aisha Patel: add it to the onboarding doc in Confluence under "Hardware Inventory" or ping me and I'll add it. Also FYI we do a quick intro sync at 3pm PT — come by #platform for a short hello if you're free.
Eliot Ramos: welcome Sam! two fun facts: I'm terrible at ping-pong and I bring cookies on Fridays. :cookie: Looking forward to pairing on infra flareups.
Sam Wells: love cookies. :grin: Thanks everyone — tagging this thread as resolved for my checklist.
Aisha Patel: sweet — congrats and welcome again :party-parrot: 
ops-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: MDM (done), VPN (done), SSH (done).
